findings.failing_input: STORE_NAMES is hardcoded as 3-tuple. STORES_WITH_TIKTOK currently only has 'uzoshop'. If a new store adopts TikTok, only this Set needs updating — but the dashboard would also need column rendering changes. Documented intent: 'single source of truth' is honored.
findings.fix_sketch: None unless we transition to dynamic store discovery (out of scope).
findings.regression_test_idea: None — config drift is a process gate.

findings.failing_input: storeHasTikTok takes string|null|undefined and checks Set membership. If a future caller passes a store ID instead of name (e.g. 'uzoshop' is both ID and name, but 'Zol Plus' name vs 'zolplus' ID), the Set would miss the ID variant.
findings.expected: Comment notes both ID + name in STORE_ID_TO_NAME (line 14) but this module doesn't actually export that map.
findings.actual: Works because uzoshop ID === uzoshop name; would fail for non-uzoshop if they had TikTok.
findings.fix_sketch: Add STORE_ID_TO_NAME export OR document that storeHasTikTok takes the NAME variant only.
findings.regression_test_idea: storeHasTikTok('uzoshop') → true; storeHasTikTok('Zol Plus') → false; storeHasTikTok('zolplus') → currently false (but should fail loudly if a Zol-Plus-with-TikTok future exists).

uncertainty_notes: Clear module purpose. Documentation references STORES_WITH_TIKTOK in cronDaily.ts and cronLive.ts — those should also import from here (verify in graph). Today's only TikTok store is uzoshop where ID === name, so the latent ID-vs-name issue (STA-28) is dormant.
